official: 大田区行政手続条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会区長提出議案

name: 不利益処分の公示通知方法を変更
summary: 現在、区の行政手続条例では、不利益処分を受ける人への通知を公示で行う場合の方法などを定めています。この議案では、公示する内容を広く閲覧できる状態にし、区の事務所の掲示場への掲示または事務所内の電子機器画面での閲覧を可能にします。公示の措置を始めてから2週間が過ぎると、通知が届いたものと扱い、2026年5月21日から施行します。
changes: 公示する内容を規則で定める方法により不特定多数が閲覧できる状態に置く
区の事務所の掲示場への掲示、または事務所内の電子機器画面での閲覧を可能にする
公示の措置を始めてから2週間後に通知が届いたものとみなす
条例中の「名あて人」を「名宛人」に改める
who: 不利益処分について公示で通知を受ける人や事業者
why: 行政手続法の改正に伴い、聴聞の実施などの通知に係る公示送達の方法を改め、規定を整備するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how notices of adverse dispositions are made public
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ota City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, the ward's Administrative Procedure Ordinance sets out methods for notifying people who are subject to adverse dispositions by public notice. This bill makes the contents of public notices widely available for viewing and allows them to be posted on noticeboards at ward offices or viewed on electronic device screens inside those offices. A notice is treated as delivered two weeks after the public-notice measures begin. The ordinance takes effect on May 21, 2026.
changes: Make the contents of public notices viewable by an unspecified number of people, using a method set by rules
Allow the contents to be posted on noticeboards at ward offices or viewed on electronic device screens inside those offices
Treat a notice as delivered two weeks after the public-notice measures begin
Change the Japanese term for “addressee” in the ordinance from 「名あて人」 to 「名宛人」
who: People and businesses receiving notice of adverse dispositions by public notice
People and businesses able to view the contents of public notices
People and businesses receiving notice through ward-office noticeboards or electronic screens
Addressees of notices about adverse dispositions
en.why: The ward says this is to revise the methods for serving notices by public notice in connection with notices about hearings and other matters, and to update related provisions, following amendments to the Administrative Procedure Act.
